variants.name: full-swiglu-fused
variants.hypothesis: Full fused SwiGLU reference at the fixed v2 backbone.

variants.name: full-gelu
variants.hypothesis: Full GELU reference with equal FFN weights.

variants.name: narrow-swiglu-fused
variants.hypothesis: Compact dense reference at the shared-bank parameter budget.

variants.name: narrow-gelu
variants.hypothesis: Compact GELU reference at the shared-bank parameter budget.

variants.name: shared-basis
variants.hypothesis: Reuse detectors to expose twice as many features as the equal-weight compact dense bank.

variants.name: gate-transport
variants.hypothesis: Layer-specific neighboring-feature products improve shared-bank reuse; train only if it passes the registered hardware screen.

variants.name: untied-basis
variants.hypothesis: Untie identically initialized detectors to measure the training cost of sharing; not a size-matched control.
